name: Kitsune no xxx
source:
Because of your frail health from birth, you have been living with a servant in a mansion secluded from people since the age of eight.  
Even after nearly eight years had passed, there was no sign of your health improving, and you spent peaceful days with the servant.
However, one day, due to a fox mask given to you by the servant as a charm, those days gradually began to fall apart…

[Translated from official game synopsis]
translation:
由于你生来体弱多病，从八岁起就和仆人住在与世隔绝的宅邸里。
近八年过去了，你的身体却没有任何好转的迹象，和仆人一起度过了平静的日子。
然而有一天，因为仆人送给你的一张狐狸面具作为符咒，那些日子渐渐开始分崩离析……

【翻译自官方游戏简介】
